inventory_method: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -- packages/core packages/redis; complete safe text reads; generated result payloads excluded
acceptance: No implementation, frontend parity, live-runtime, SQL backing or declaration acceptance is claimed. Frozen state/history/security ports are classified, not re-reviewed.
row_semantics: Each file inherits framework_dependency, target_path, preservation_action and blocker from its profile. $path resolves to that row's exact path; retained package source is not relocated. Override fields in a row take precedence. Proposed targets are not existing accepted ports.

active_manifest.framework_dependency: Not accepted: active core declaration writer
active_manifest.preservation_action: Metadata classification only; do not edit or treat mutable declarations as reviewed dependencies

generated_result.preservation_action: Exclude payload inspection and production migration; preserve existing file
generated_result.blocker: Generated running output forbidden; historical results do not establish current acceptance

check_source.preservation_action: Read source only; preserve fixture/check source; do not execute, copy outputs or repeat frozen reviews

tsconfig.preservation_action: Retain config; later verify backend runtime/declarations without running checks in this audit
